{{Quote|He's gone&mdash;dead at the hands of an overenthusiastic agent. That's why Minder Four is no longer with us.|Watcher Two|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Minder Four''' was a [[Minder (Imperial Intelligence)|Minder]] in [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Minder Four was overenthusiastic in the interrogation of the former master of a rebel slave named [[Jurithus]], and Minder Four's job was terminated when the subject [[Death/Legends|died]] in the interrogation.
